contract_proof.authority: telemetry_events remains unchanged and authoritative; projection rows retain event_id and ingested_seq lineage without raw payload copies
contract_proof.atomicity: each global event receipt is claimed before identity/stage/aggregate mutation; receipt disposition, derived rows, revision, scoped quarantine truth, and contiguous checkpoint then commit in one PostgreSQL transaction
contract_proof.idempotency: an all-exact-duplicate batch short-circuits before every derived mutation and before revision/freshness changes; mixed batches apply only new-receipt-owned rows and fail closed on ambiguous shared aggregate ownership; conflicting fingerprints fail closed
contract_proof.checkpoint: a recursive indexed query derives the highest contiguous receipt sequence from durable database truth and crosses a previously persisted gap tail only after the missing receipt arrives
contract_proof.freshness: accepted_live and last_live_success_at can advance only in live mode; backfill, recovery, and replay own separate timestamps
contract_proof.writer_exclusion: a stable SHA-256-derived signed bigint scopes pg_try_advisory_xact_lock across independent Python processes; different overlapping controller locks still serialize on the global receipt claim, and a concurrent loser rolls back before derived mutation
contract_proof.identity: the CHECK registry covers the existing materializer resolve identifiers and lifecycle stable identities; first/last source time and sequence bounds converge with LEAST/GREATEST
contract_proof.least_privilege: bootstrap is explicit and reads the versioned migration file; the runtime constructor defaults to no DDL and was exercised with a DML-only PostgreSQL login that could not create a schema
contract_proof.quarantine: unresolved counts are recomputed from controller-scoped unresolved rows, and an exact retry cannot increment occurrence or controller count

They were deleted by 23ae23c2185d31d2aeacafaa9b051127a6d53136 (PR #4590), a stale-base squash that removed 166 files and 47932 lines from dev, including this task's sibling evidence directories LIFECYCLE-PROJ-INCIDENT-20260801 and LIFECYCLE-PROJ-HOTFIX-REVIEW-20260801. The workflow is still present on master.
